Bug_Details:
Leaking resources in an application is never a good idea, as it can lead to memory issues, and even the crash of the application. This rule
template allows you to specify which constructions open a resource and how it is closed in order to raise issue within a method scope when custom
resources are leaked.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by not closing the custom resource, resulting in a leak
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggered the bug by creating an InputStream resource that was not closed in the showBug method.
